_help: The 'Now' card on the hub. If 'slides' has entries, the card is a rotating banner (one slide per project, pips to switch, auto-cycles). Otherwise 'building'/'playing' show as before; a blank title hides an entry. url is optional. art: anyps | wizard | none.

building.title: AnyPS native cores
building.note: Rebuilding the PS1 and PS2 from scratch inside AnyPS. The PS1 now runs in 4K and widescreen; the PS2's own graphics renderer is coming together.

slides.title: AnyPS native cores
slides.note: The rebuilt PS1 now runs classic games at up to 4K and in widescreen, with no outside emulator. Next up: the PS2's own graphics renderer — pixel-exact in early tests, now getting faster and covering more games.

slides.title: Supreme Lobbing
slides.note: A physics lobbing battle in the arcade — pick a crew, work through the campaign, grow an upgrade tree and unlock prestige powers. A fresh polish pass lands most days.

slides.title: The Great Andersian Update
slides.note: AndersCraft's biggest patch is live: its own Andersian Mark currency, a crimson transmog set, roaming rares and a daily bounty board, hardcore 'Chosen' titles, and prestige levels past 125. And the editor behind it all is now a free download for other server owners.
